stem: Plants have two transport tissues, xylem and phloem.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe and explain two ways in which the structure of xylem vessels is adapted to their function.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe two differences between the vessels that transport phloem sap in flowering plants and the vessels that transport blood in mammals.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain why the root hair cells in Fig. 6.1 have more mitochondria than the other root cells shown.
